theorem: a nonconstant rational map of degree d taking values in a set of size s on N distinct finite target points satisfies N <= s*d
proof_kernel: the product over output values of (R-a) has N zeros and pole degree at most s*d
closed_classes: poly(log n)-degree direct rational parity decoder
poly(log n)-degree direct rational W_G decoder
poly(log n)-degree finite-image rational state with poly(log n) output values
not_closed: field-valued states with exponentially many values
CM Miller theta p-adic query-dependent states
